scope.primary: All current Python and shell/Slurm source files recursively under fastfill/v1_1, including tests.
scope.dependencies: The separately listed linked production dependency files only; not the entire OptiScene repository.
scope.full_read_definition: At least one fresh audit manifest explicitly records a full source read with SHA-256 equal to the current file. Initial inventory and executed test lines do not count as source reads.
scope.partial_rule: Older hashes and partial/unspecified reads remain visible as other_read_evidence and cannot establish current full coverage.
scope.line_coverage_definition: Test-executed Python source lines, measured by the cited stdlib tracing artifacts; separate from source-read coverage. The evaluator region measurement is explicitly partial.
limitations: Full source review does not prove absence of defects or scientific validity.
No whole-repository or whole-pipeline 80% execution-coverage claim is made.
This manifest describes the final local audited source; the active experiment still uses its separately identified frozen source and newly deployed gates.
